festival.title: The Festival
festival.description: Sticks n' Festival is the first Latin American festival dedicated exclusively to cinema and creative arts generated with Artificial Intelligence. Born in Montevideo, Uruguay, it seeks to be a bridge between local talent and the global avant-garde.
festival.description2: We explore new narratives, aesthetics, and production methods where human creativity merges with algorithmic power. We are a space for exhibition, debate, and experimentation.

bios.alvaroBrechner: Award-winning director and screenwriter ('A Twelve-Year Night', 'Mr. Kaplan'). His films have premiered at Cannes and Venice, representing Uruguay at the Oscars multiple times.
bios.fedeAlvarez: Hollywood director known for 'Alien: Romulus', 'Don't Breathe', and 'Evil Dead'. He burst onto the scene with the viral short 'Panic Attack!' featuring giant robots invading Montevideo.
bios.luisaPereira: Artist, engineer, and musician based in NYC. Professor at NYU ITP/IMA. Her interactive installations and generative machines explore the intersection of music and code.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Films where AI tools (generative video, voice, script) play a significant role in the creative process.
faq.q2: Can I submit if I'm not from Latam?
faq.a2: Yes! We have international categories. We welcome creators from all over the world.

submit.title: Competitions & Submission
submit.intro: We are looking for visionary works that challenge the status quo of filmmaking. Open to creators from all over the world, with a special spotlight on Latin American talent.

short.name: AI Short Film
short.desc: Narrative or documentary short films where AI played a significant role in production.

experimental.name: Experimental / Video Art
experimental.desc: Abstract, non-narrative, or conceptual works exploring the aesthetics of AI.

immersive.name: Interactive / Immersive
immersive.desc: VR, AR, or real-time experiences powered by AI.

musicVideo.name: Music Video
musicVideo.desc: Original music videos with significant AI-generated visual or audio components.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
items: Must use AI tools in a significant way (visuals, audio, script).
Open to all nationalities (LATAM creators eligible for special awards).
English subtitles required for non-English works.

criteria.title: Selection Criteria
items: Innovation in the use of AI tools.
